pool.spieler_elfmeter_wunsch.e.e1: {b.gruss} {b.spieler_elfmeter_wunsch_lage} I want to be the penalty taker. Give me the ball.
pool.spieler_elfmeter_wunsch.e.e2: {b.gruss} {b.spieler_elfmeter_wunsch_lage} Next penalty, I want to take it. I'll score it.
pool.spieler_elfmeter_wunsch.e.e3: {b.gruss} {b.spieler_elfmeter_wunsch_lage} Honestly, I don't get why someone else takes them when I'm in this form.
pool.spieler_elfmeter_wunsch.e.e4: {b.gruss} {b.spieler_elfmeter_wunsch_lage} I'm tired of watching. Penalties are my thing, you know that.
pool.spieler_elfmeter_wunsch.e.e5: {b.gruss} {b.spieler_elfmeter_wunsch_lage} I don't want to push in, but I'd like to take over the penalties.
pool.spieler_elfmeter_wunsch.e.e6: {b.gruss} {b.spieler_elfmeter_wunsch_lage} Strikers at the big clubs take their own penalties. Why not me?
pool.spieler_elfmeter_wunsch.a.a1: Agreed. From the next game, they're yours.
pool.spieler_elfmeter_wunsch.a.a2: The order follows our shoot-out drills in training. Show me there.
pool.spieler_elfmeter_wunsch.a.a3: You're second in line. If the first one isn't on the pitch, the ball is yours.
pool.spieler_elfmeter_wunsch.a.a4: No. I decide who shoots, not the stats.
pool.spieler_elfmeter_wunsch.a.a5: I can see how good you are right now. Let's decide this together, calmly.
pool.spieler_elfmeter_wunsch.a.a6: Talk to the assistant, he plans the set pieces.
pool.spieler_elfmeter_wunsch.a.a7: And if you miss, in the last minute, in the derby. Can you handle that?
pool.spieler_elfmeter_wunsch.a.a8: The order stays. Focus on your goals from open play.
pool.spieler_elfmeter_wunsch.r.r1: {b.gut} Thanks, boss. I won't let you down.
pool.spieler_elfmeter_wunsch.r.r2: {b.gut} That's what I wanted to hear. The next one goes in.
pool.spieler_elfmeter_wunsch.r.r3: {b.gut} Fair. I'll take any role that helps the team.
pool.spieler_elfmeter_wunsch.r.r4: {b.neutral} Okay. I'll show it in training.
pool.spieler_elfmeter_wunsch.r.r6: {b.neutral} No drama. We'll talk again in a few weeks.
pool.spieler_elfmeter_wunsch.r.r8: {b.schlecht} That's a joke. I score everything here and I'm not allowed to shoot?
pool.spieler_elfmeter_wunsch.r.r9: {b.schlecht} Somewhere else they'd give me the ball.
pool.spieler_elfmeter_wunsch.x.x1: He nods and heads to training. {entscheidung}
pool.spieler_elfmeter_wunsch.x.x2: He leaves without many words. {entscheidung} Everyone will be watching at the next penalty.
pool.spieler_elfmeter_wunsch.x.x3: He slams the door. {entscheidung} The penalty question becomes a dressing-room topic.
pool.spieler_belastung_pause.e.e1: {b.gruss} {b.spieler_belastung_pause_lage} I need a game off. Otherwise something will happen.
pool.spieler_belastung_pause.e.e2: {b.gruss} {b.spieler_belastung_pause_lage} I'm not trying to dodge anything, but I'm shattered.
pool.spieler_belastung_pause.e.e3: {b.gruss} {b.spieler_belastung_pause_lage} I can feel it in the sprints, I can't keep up any more.
pool.spieler_belastung_pause.e.e4: {b.gruss} {b.spieler_belastung_pause_lage} If you keep playing me every week, I'll be injured by spring.
pool.spieler_belastung_pause.e.e5: {b.gruss} {b.spieler_belastung_pause_lage} Can I be on the bench this weekend? Just this once.
pool.spieler_belastung_pause.e.e6: {b.gruss} {b.spieler_belastung_pause_lage} The doctor says nothing, but my body says plenty.
pool.spieler_belastung_pause.a.a1: You get the next game off. Recover.
pool.spieler_belastung_pause.a.a2: We'll lower the load in training, but you have to play.
pool.spieler_belastung_pause.a.a3: You start on the bench and come on after an hour.
pool.spieler_belastung_pause.a.a4: Everyone's tired. We need you on the pitch.
pool.spieler_belastung_pause.a.a5: Thanks for being honest. I'd rather hear it than see you injured.
pool.spieler_belastung_pause.a.a6: Get checked by the physios, then we'll decide.
pool.spieler_belastung_pause.a.a7: Who should replace you? Give me a name.
pool.spieler_belastung_pause.a.a8: You push on until the international break.
pool.spieler_belastung_pause.r.r1: {b.gut} Thanks. I'll be back at full speed after that.
pool.spieler_belastung_pause.r.r3: {b.gut} Good to know people listen here.
pool.spieler_belastung_pause.r.r7: {b.schlecht} If I get injured, you'll know why.
pool.spieler_belastung_pause.r.r9: {b.schlecht} Then I won't say anything any more.
pool.spieler_belastung_pause.x.x2: He shrugs. {entscheidung} The coming weeks will show whether he lasts.
pool.spieler_belastung_pause.x.x3: He leaves without a word. {entscheidung} Others in the dressing room wonder whether they're being run into the ground too.
pool.spieler_kapitaensbinde.e.e1: {b.gruss} {b.spieler_kapitaensbinde_lage} I want to be captain. I think the team sees it the same way.
pool.spieler_kapitaensbinde.e.e2: {b.gruss} {b.spieler_kapitaensbinde_lage} The armband would be an honour for me. Think about it.
pool.spieler_kapitaensbinde.e.e3: {b.gruss} {b.spieler_kapitaensbinde_lage} I already speak up in the dressing room when things are on fire. I may as well wear the armband.
pool.spieler_kapitaensbinde.e.e4: {b.gruss} {b.spieler_kapitaensbinde_lage} With respect: the armband is on the wrong arm right now.
pool.spieler_kapitaensbinde.e.e5: {b.gruss} {b.spieler_kapitaensbinde_lage} I don't want to take anything from anyone, but I'd take on responsibility.
pool.spieler_kapitaensbinde.e.e6: {b.gruss} {b.spieler_kapitaensbinde_lage} Other players come to me with their problems anyway. Make it official.
pool.spieler_kapitaensbinde.a.a1: You're right. You wear the armband from now on.
pool.spieler_kapitaensbinde.a.a2: A captain isn't requested, he grows into it. You're on the way.
pool.spieler_kapitaensbinde.a.a3: You'll be vice-captain and lead the players' council.
pool.spieler_kapitaensbinde.a.a4: I decide who's captain. The question doesn't arise.
pool.spieler_kapitaensbinde.a.a5: I'm glad you think like that. Keep showing it, I see it.
pool.spieler_kapitaensbinde.a.a6: The team should elect the captain. Stand for it.
pool.spieler_kapitaensbinde.a.a7: And what do you tell the captain when you take the armband off him?
pool.spieler_kapitaensbinde.a.a8: The armband stays where it is. You can lead without it.
pool.spieler_kapitaensbinde.r.r2: {b.gut} That's a big step for me.
pool.spieler_kapitaensbinde.r.r3: {b.gut} I'll take the job seriously, I promise.
pool.spieler_kapitaensbinde.r.r6: {b.neutral} Fine. It's about the team for me, not a piece of fabric.
pool.spieler_kapitaensbinde.r.r7: {b.schlecht} Then I know where I stand.
pool.spieler_kapitaensbinde.r.r8: {b.schlecht} Typical. The loud ones never get heard here.
pool.spieler_kapitaensbinde.r.r9: {b.schlecht} Maybe they value me more somewhere else.
pool.spieler_kapitaensbinde.x.x1: He leaves with his head up. {entscheidung}
pool.spieler_kapitaensbinde.x.x2: He gives a short nod. {entscheidung} The hierarchy in the dressing room stays a topic.
pool.spieler_kapitaensbinde.x.x3: It gets loud. {entscheidung} The captain hears about it the same day.
pool.spieler_sponsortermin.e.e1: {b.gruss} {b.spieler_sponsortermin_lage} I'm not doing the sponsor event tomorrow. I'm not in the mood for photos.
pool.spieler_sponsortermin.e.e2: {b.gruss} {b.spieler_sponsortermin_lage} Can someone else go to the sponsor? I need the day for myself.
pool.spieler_sponsortermin.e.e3: {b.gruss} {b.spieler_sponsortermin_lage} I'm a footballer, not an advertising face.
pool.spieler_sponsortermin.e.e4: {b.gruss} {b.spieler_sponsortermin_lage} Three appearances in one week is too much. I'm cancelling.
pool.spieler_sponsortermin.e.e5: {b.gruss} {b.spieler_sponsortermin_lage} Please don't get me wrong, but I don't want to grin into a camera tomorrow.
pool.spieler_sponsortermin.e.e6: {b.gruss} {b.spieler_sponsortermin_lage} The sponsor pays the club, not me. Why should I go?
pool.spieler_sponsortermin.a.a1: All right, I'll send someone else. Take the day.
pool.spieler_sponsortermin.a.a2: The sponsors help pay your wages too. One hour, then you're free.
pool.spieler_sponsortermin.a.a3: We'll cut it to half an hour, no interview.
pool.spieler_sponsortermin.a.a4: It's in your contract. You're going.
pool.spieler_sponsortermin.a.a5: What's going on? Let's talk about that first, then about the event.
pool.spieler_sponsortermin.a.a6: Sort it out with the marketing department.
pool.spieler_sponsortermin.a.a7: And if tomorrow's paper says you think you're too good for it?
pool.spieler_sponsortermin.a.a8: You go. Then we'll talk about the week.
pool.spieler_sponsortermin.r.r2: {b.gut} Okay, I'll keep it short then.
pool.spieler_sponsortermin.r.r3: {b.gut} Good that you ask what's going on.
pool.spieler_sponsortermin.r.r4: {b.neutral} Fine. But I won't be smiling.
pool.spieler_sponsortermin.r.r8: {b.schlecht} Then I'll go and say what I think.
pool.spieler_sponsortermin.r.r9: {b.schlecht} We'll see how much longer I put up with this.
pool.spieler_sponsortermin.x.x2: He leaves, his mood still sour. {entscheidung} The sponsor will notice.
pool.spieler_sponsortermin.x.x3: He doesn't turn up the next day. {entscheidung} Marketing is furious.
